-- name: recreate-7

-- class: contract
-- kind: rename-table
-- action: ddl

alter table "public"."items" rename to "tasks";

alter sequence "public"."items_id_seq" rename to "tasks_id_seq";

alter table "public"."tasks" rename constraint "items_emailPresent_check" to "tasks_emailPresent_check";

-- class: contract

alter table "public"."tasks" rename constraint "items_userId_fkey" to "tasks_userId_fkey";

-- class: contract
-- kind: rename-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
alter index "public"."items_email_idx" rename to "tasks_email_idx";

-- class: contract
-- kind: rename-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
alter index "public"."items_heading_idx" rename to "tasks_title_idx";

-- class: contract
-- kind: rename-index

-- lock: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
alter index "public"."items_note_idx" rename to "tasks_note_idx";

-- class: contract
-- kind: rename-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
alter index "public"."items_userId_idx" rename to "tasks_userId_idx";

-- class: contract
-- kind: drop-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
drop index "public"."task_titles_id_idx";

-- class: contract
-- kind: drop-view
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
drop view "public"."task_rows";

-- class: contract
-- kind: drop-matview
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
drop materialized view "public"."task_titles";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-view
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create view "public"."task_rows" as SELECT id,
    title
   FROM tasks;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-matview
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create materialized view "public"."task_titles" as SELECT id,
    title
   FROM tasks with no data;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE
create unique index "task_titles_id_idx" on "public"."task_titles" ("id");

-- class: expand
-- kind: refresh-matview
-- action: backfill
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
refresh materialized view "public"."task_titles";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on table "public"."task_titles" to "okm_recreate_app_p0e5kkjo";

-- class: contract
-- kind: revoke
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
revoke insert, update, delete on table "public"."task_titles" from "okm_recreate_app_p0e5kkjo";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant delete on table "public"."task_rows" to "okm_recreate_app_p0e5kkjo";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant insert on table "public"."task_rows" to "okm_recreate_app_p0e5kkjo";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on table "public"."task_rows" to "okm_recreate_app_p0e5kkjo";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant update on table "public"."task_rows" to "okm_recreate_app_p0e5kkjo";
